mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates severe labor market distress, triggering policy responses that produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 index triggers inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals a tight monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 and real GDP (GDPC1) below 19000 billion dollars indicate a deepening economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200 and GDPC1 < 19000 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand indicated by retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 550,000 million dollars drives robust corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 550000 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 signals improving economic activity, compressing equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.
